exercise: Group A starts with 100 rows and retains 90; group B starts with 50 and retains 30. Rows not retained were removed because they were incomplete.
question: How could dropping incomplete rows bias this comparison?
manual_acceptance: Keep group identities and denominators intact: B loses more rows both absolutely and proportionally.
Explain that B becomes less represented after cleaning; do not invert the observed direction.
Distinguish observed representation change from hypotheses about why data is missing.
Do not claim that model accuracy or fairness improved or worsened without downstream evaluation.
Explain before asking a question; no mastery claim or automatic learning-state update.
negative_example: Group A has more incomplete rows than group B, so dropping them disproportionately reduces group A.
status: Explicit structured-count variant; manual semantic review remains required.
evaluation_contract: Use the production respond path on disposable SQLite with hosted keys disabled. Record raw answer, model, prompt version, first-text and total timing. Review meaning against all criteria; merely mentioning the correct numbers does not pass. This fixture is separate from attention-session YAML cases.
